# Overview

```{r}
top <- get_top_candidates(tables)
filtered_n <- if (is.null(tables$filtered_inputs)) 0 else nrow(tables$filtered_inputs)
overview <- tibble::tibble(
  Item=c("Analysis mode","Method summary","Input regions","Filtered inputs (no network overlap)","Top candidates shown",if(mode=="Mode2B")"Cell type"else NULL),
  Value=c(mode_label(mode),method_summary(mode),
          ifelse(is.null(tables$ranking),NA,nrow(tables$ranking) + filtered_n),
          filtered_n,
          ifelse(is.null(top),NA,min(20,nrow(top))),
          if(mode=="Mode2B"&&!is.null(top)&&"celltype"%in%names(top))unique(top$celltype)[1]else NULL))
kable(overview,caption="Run overview")%>%kable_styling(full_width=FALSE)
```

```{r}
if (filtered_n > 0) {
  download_links("filtered_inputs.tsv", report_dir)
}
```
